Rooms.Name: The Old Well
Rooms.Description:
The well doesn't look that unused as you thought it should be. In 
fact it looks like it has been used every day. You see rungs leading 
down into the darkness below. The main farm house lies to the north 
and to the west you see a large wild grown field.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you look closer you see that some of the rungs have been replaced 
with new ones.

Rooms.Name: Down in the well
Rooms.Description:
This is a dark and slippery place, filled with maggots and rotten 
smells. The ladder is rusty, and you wonder if the rung will really 
hold you and all that equipment you insist on having with you.

Exits.Description: You see the light of the sky up there.
The ladder leads further down into the darkness.

Rooms.Name: Further down in the well
Rooms.Description:
The rotten smells are almost intolerable down here. The brick walls 
here is very old and whole sections have fallen down into the dark 
water far below you.

Exits.Description: You see a small dot up there that you think is the sky over EliteMud.

The ladder leads further down into the darkness, but the rung is VERY 
rusty and will probably fall apart if you try them.

There is a hole here that your probably can squeeze you through, if you 
take away some stones.

Rooms.Name: Small room
Rooms.Description:
This room is quite small, and the stone bricks on the walls are 
marked with erosion. A small stone door is on the west wall, with 
ancient symbols carved into it. There is a hole in the east wall 
that you probably can squeeze you through.

Rooms.Name: Entrance room
Rooms.Description:
The ancient stonewalls are covered here by black tapestries with 
strange symbols on them. The room extends further to the north and a 
black painted door leads to the west. A small stone door is on the east 
wall.

Exits.Description: The room extends further to the north.
The black door is on this wall, between two black tapestries.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The tapestries are very ancient, and now as you look at them, the 
symbols must actually be letters in an unknown language.

Rooms.Name: Dark corridor
Rooms.Description:
This corridor is filled up to your knees with a gray, thick, slow 
moving smoke. The walls here are completely black with strange symbols 
painted in purple.

Exits.Description: There is a door on this wall.

Rooms.Name: Dark corridor
Rooms.Description:
This corridor is filled up to your knees with a gray, thick, slow 
moving smoke. The walls here are completely black with strange symbols 
painted in purple.

Rooms.Name: Dark corridor
Rooms.Description:
The corridor is filled up to your waist with a gray, thick, slow 
moving smoke, making your feet impossible to spot. The corridor opens 
up into a room to the west.

Exits.Description: The room to the west is even more filled with the gray smoke.

Rooms.Name: Smoke filled room
Rooms.Description:
The room is almost completely filled with the thick smoke. The smoke 
seems to flow through the room in a very strange way. It's almost as if 
you can see the smoke turn into cloaked figures, moving in a ancient 
dance of death.

Rooms.Name: Smoke filled room
Rooms.Description:
The room is almost completely filled with the thick, gray smoke. Here 
the smoke is almost at rest, only moving by the sudden movements of your 
body.

Exits.Description: The smoke seems to be less thick to the west.

Rooms.Name: Smoke filled room
Rooms.Description:
The room is almost completely filled with the thick, gray smoke. The 
smoke is moving through this room in a very strange way. It's almost as 
if you can see the smoke turn into cloaked figures, moving in an ancient 
dance of death.

Rooms.Name: Smoke filled room
Rooms.Description:
The room is almost completely filled with the thick, slow moving 
smoke. The smoke seems to flow around you and grapple your body in a 
most disturbing way.

Rooms.Name: Smoke filled room
Rooms.Description:
This part of the room IS completely filled with the gray smoke, 
making breathing almost impossible. You wonder if this smoke is 
poisonous to inhale.

Exits.Description: The smoke seems to be less thick to the south.

Rooms.Name: Dark corridor
Rooms.Description:
The corridor is filled up to your waist with the gray smoke. To the 
east you see a room filled with this strange smoke. The corridor bends 
to the south here.

Exits.Description: The room seems to be completely filled with smoke.

Rooms.Name: Dark corridor
Rooms.Description:
At last you leave the smoke behind you as you enter this part of the
corridor. The corridor leads into the darkness to the north, and to the 
east into a narrower part of the corridor. To the south there is an 
old oak door.

Exits.Description: Smoke slowly moves towards you from the north.
The corridor stretches further to the east.
Yes, there is definitely a door to the south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The door must be very old because it fits exactly into the door frame.

Rooms.Name: The dining room
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a quite big room with rows of tables and chairs. On 
the walls hangs black tapestries of assassins killing king Welmar. The 
air is filled with an aroma of lobsters and sweet wine. Who makes this 
good and expensive food for the foul assassins?

Exits.Description:
The room to the west must be the kitchen. You hear the well-known noises 
of someone making a nice dinner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Its certainly King Welmar on one of the tapestries, but he looks much 
younger on it, and quite dead too with a knife in his back.

Rooms.Name: The Kitchen
Rooms.Description:
The kitchen is filled with tools needed for making food. A big 
cauldron with lobster soup stands here over a small fire. You suddenly 
think back to the loaves of bread you always eat when hungry and wonder 
if the soup is as good as it smells. To the east is the eating area and 
to the west is a small door, probably to the food storage.

Exits.Description: The door to the west is small and very fragile.
The door is very very fragile and would probably break if you bash it.

and the walls is made of packed earth. The 
room is filled with sacks and barrels with food and wine. With all this 
food this organization will not be starving for years. The only exit is 
through the door to the east.

Rooms.Name: Dimly lit corridor
Rooms.Description:
The corridor's only light source is a small flickering torch on the 
south wall. The bricks here are painted black making this a quite scary 
place. The corridor continues to the west and the east. A black door 
with a small sign is to the north.

Exits.Description: The black door has a sign on it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: There is a sign on the black door.

The sign says:


           THE TRAINING ROOM

Rooms.Name: The assassins training room
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a big room with gray walls a big nice carpet of 
Arabian quality. A huge amount of wicked weapons hangs on the walls, 
some of them you recognize, others are very strange and old. Three 
dummies stand near the north wall, looking somewhat smashed. The only 
exit is through the door to the south.

Exits.Description: The door leads out to the corridor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The assassins must be fond of cutting these dummies throats because it 
looks like they have been repaired there several times.

The weapons looks extremely deadly. Wonder if the assassins train with 
razor-sharp weapons?

Rooms.Name: Dimly lit corridor
Rooms.Description:
This part of the corridor is completely silent. You see small 
puddles of fresh blood on the floor. Someone must have been killed here 
recently. The corridor continues to the east and west, and there is a 
door on the north wall with a small sign.

Exits.Description: There is a door on the north wall, made of oak.
You see that the corridor continues to the east.
The corridor continues to the west.

You see that the blood comes from a small trapdoor in the ceiling. 
Suddenly a blood drop lands on your shoulder. Yuck!

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The door is made of oak, and there is a sign on it.

The sign says:

              MEDITATION CHAMBER

The trapdoor is small and fits well into the ceiling. You are very 
lucky that you even saw it.

Rooms.Name: Meditation chamber
Rooms.Description:
The air in this room is filled with a soft, narcotic aroma that makes 
your head spin. On small tables by the walls stands hundreds of small 
candles which provides a eerie feeling over the place. On the floor is 
a big black carpet with strange golden symbols woven into it. The only 
exit is through the door to the south.

Exits.Description: You see a door.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The carpet is very beautiful but too heavy for you to take with you.

Rooms.Name: Secret room
Rooms.Description:
These assassins must be maniacs! The floor is almost completely 
filled with fresh corpses, and you can't move an inch without steeping 
into a puddle of blood. Is this place a storage room for corpses?

Exits.Description: There is a trapdoor under all the corpses.

Rooms.Name: Dimly lit corridor
Rooms.Description:
You are at a bend of the corridor. It stretches further to the west 
and to the south. The smell of something sticky and poisonous catch 
your nose from the south corridor. There is a black painted door on the 
north wall.

Exits.Description: There is a door on the north wall.
There is strange smell coming from this corridor.
The corridor continues to the west.

Rooms.Name: Barracks
Rooms.Description:
This sparsely equipped room must be the assassins sleeping quarters. 
Rows of small and not so comfortable beds stand by the walls, there 
must be some 20 beds here. Why don't you count the beds and then see 
if you have killed the right number of baddies down here? (grin). The 
room extends further to the east, and there is a door to the south here.

Exits.Description: Someone must have a candle lit to the east.
Yes, there is a door there.

Rooms.Name: The inner part of the barracks
Rooms.Description:
These beds seems even more uncomfortable than the beds in the west 
part of the room. They are made of stone! On a small table by a bed is 
a lit candle. The only apparent exit is to the west.

Exits.Description: The room extends further to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The candle seems to have burned halfway and is firmly attached to the 
table.

Rooms.Name: Smelly part of the corridor
Rooms.Description:
There is a poisonous smell in the air here, mainly coming from the 
door to the east. There is a sign on the door too. You see the end of 
the corridor to the south and a bend of the corridor to the north.

Exits.Description: You see a bend in the corridor to the north.
There is a door to the east, with a sign on it.
You see three doors at the end of the corridor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign says:

   The hall of the Poisonlord.
    
          Keep out !!

Rooms.Name: The hall of the Poisonlord
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a great underground hall, probably a natural cave. 
Huge black tapestries cover the gray stone walls, with a very ugly and 
horrible face woven in gold on each of them. To the east you see a pool 
filled with a boiling liquid, the smell of acidic venom is almost 
intolerable in here.

Exits.Description: You the pool to the east.
The door leads out to the corridor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The eyes on the huge ugly faces seems to follow your every move.

Rooms.Name: By the Pool
Rooms.Description:
You stand by the 10 feet wide pool. Lethal fumes is emerging from the 
boiling surface of the liquid, making you cough.  On tables around the 
pool stands hundreds of small flasks and bottles with weird looking tags 
labels on each of them. A huge humanoid stands by the pool, wearing a 
black robe and a hood that puts its face in shadow. He radiates a 
feeling of complete corruption. Suddenly you realize that this is the 
guy on the tapestries to the west.

Exits.Description: You see the door at the end of the hall.
The pool doesn't look nice to jump into. Do you really wanna try that?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The pool is filled with a green boiling liquid that must be poison. 
Bubbles with gray smoke is constantly emerging on the surface.

The stuff in the bottles seems to be ingredients to the liquid in the 
pool. Do not touch them, they must be poisonous too!

Rooms.Name: By the end of the corridor
Rooms.Description:
You stand at the end of the long corridor. The bricks on the walls 
are really old here, looking like they have been there for thousands of 
years. A steel door is on the east wall, and on the west wall there is 
a completely normal door. Silent screams can be heard from the door to 
the south.

Exits.Description: The corridor goes back to the north.
There is a heavy steel door to the east.
Horrible screams breaks the otherwise complete silence through the door.
The door is very normal.

Rooms.Name: The Dungeons
Rooms.Description:
This prison is simply constructed, its a square room with steel bars 
running parallel with the ceiling at 8 feet high. The bars must have 
been put there to hang the prisoners upside down through their achilles 
tendons. Hoards of maggots and rats run around on the dirty floor.

Exits.Description: You see the corridor through a small window in the door.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The bars are very rusty and there is coagulated blood all over them.

Rooms.Name: The torture chamber
Rooms.Description:
This room is filled with clever tools to inflict pain into a 
creatures body and soul. Most of the stuff in here are so complex that 
it would take days for you to optimize the efficiency of them. You spot 
a iron maiden in one corner, probably out of use with all the other 
apparently effective tools here. You somehow feel the hopelessness of 
all the victims of these horrible experiment during the centuries past.

Exits.Description: The door leads out to the corridor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The steel tips in the iron maiden is very rusty. Wonder if that will 
help you a bit if you got trapped in it.

Rooms.Name: Gontran's room
Rooms.Description:
This rooms interior are very luxurious and very different to all the 
other rooms in this complex. The huge bed is made of dharian irontree, 
the furniture of Direwood and the carpet must be from Thalos. Small 
lanterns hangs in the ceiling making this room kind of a nice place. 
But the guy that lives here is probably not nice at all.

Exits.Description: The door leads out to the corridor.
There is a secret door behind the a tapestry.

Rooms.Name: Secret room
Rooms.Description:
This room is very small and the stone bricks in the walls are heavily 
eroded here. Small puddles of water is on the floor, probably the 
subsoil water that is leaking through the walls.

Exits.Description: The secret door leads to the Gontran's room.

Rooms.Name: Entrance room
Rooms.Description:
The black tapestries cover most of the walls here, with ancient 
symbols which seems to move around in small circles, although you know 
that they are well woven into the cloth. You spot a door to the west, 
and the room extends further to the south.

Exits.Description: You see the southern part of the room.
There is a door on the west wall.

Rooms.Name: A dark corridor
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a dark corridor, very dirty and with spiderwebs 
in the upper corners of the walls. To the west you see a illuminated 
hall with several mirrors reflecting your image back to you. To the east 
there is a door.

Exits.Description: You see a door to the east.
To the west lies the Hall of Mirrors.

Rooms.Name: The Hall of Mirrors
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a hall with thousands of mirrors. In the light of 
your light source you see thousands of images of yourself staring at 
you. The mirrors seems to make the proportions of the room very 
unrealistic and strange.

Rooms.Name: The Hall of Mirrors
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a hall with thousands of mirrors. In the light of 
your light source you see thousands of images of yourself staring at 
you. The mirrors seems to make the proportions of the room very 
unrealistic and strange.

Rooms.Name: The Hall of Mirrors
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a hall with thousands of mirrors. In the light of 
your light source you see thousands of images of yourself staring at 
you. The mirrors seems to make the proportions of the room very 
unrealistic and strange.

Rooms.Name: The Hall of Mirrors
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a hall with thousands of mirrors. In the light of 
your light source you see thousands of images of yourself staring at 
you. The mirrors seems to make the proportions of the room very 
unrealistic and strange.

Rooms.Name: The Hall of Mirrors
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a hall with thousands of mirrors. In the light of 
your light source you see thousands of images of yourself staring at 
you. The mirrors seems to make the proportions of the room very 
unrealistic and strange.

Rooms.Name: The Hall of Mirrors
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a hall with thousands of mirrors. In the light of 
your light source you see thousands of images of yourself staring at 
you. The mirrors seems to make the proportions of the room very 
unrealistic and strange.

Rooms.Name: The Hall of Mirrors
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a hall with thousands of mirrors. In the light of 
your light source you see thousands of images of yourself staring at 
you. The mirrors seems to make the proportions of the room very 
unrealistic and strange.

Rooms.Name: The Hall of Mirrors
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a hall with thousands of mirrors. In the light of 
your light source you see thousands of images of yourself staring at 
you. The mirrors seems to make the proportions of the room very 
unrealistic and strange.

Rooms.Name: The Hall of Mirrors
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a hall with thousands of mirrors. In the light of 
your light source you see thousands of images of yourself staring at 
you. The mirrors seems to make the proportions of the room very 
unrealistic and strange.

Rooms.Name: A dark corridor
Rooms.Description:
This corridor doesn't seem to have been used for ages. The dirt on 
the floor is almost ankle-deep and the spiderwebs are really big here. 
To the east you see the strange Hall of Mirrors, and to the west you 
see a well lit room.

Exits.Description: You see the Hall of Mirrors to the east.
You see a room to the west.

Rooms.Name: Hall of the Statues
Rooms.Description:
The entire room is filled with statues of cloaked figures. On the 
walls and in the ceiling the figures have been carved out with 
perfection from the bare rock. Several statues stands in the middle of 
the room. They look so natural that you almost think that they will 
start moving and stab you in the back! There is an exit to the east and 
one to the south.

Exits.Description: You see a corridor to the east leading to the Hall of Mirrors.
You see one more room to the south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The statues are carved out of the rock with excellent expertise. Maybe 
they are made by a dwarven artist, captured by the wicked assassins.

Rooms.Name: Skull filled room
Rooms.Description:
In the ceiling of this room hangs several complete sets of human 
bones, with rotten pieces of flesh hanging from them. In niches lies 
hundreds of humanoid skulls in rows, some half smashed, others very 
fine specimens that you could have on your table at home and recite 
Hamlet to. To the north lies the Hall of Statues and to the south you 
see the entrance to the temple.

Exits.Description: The Hall of Statues lies to the north from here.
The temple to the south seems very old and evil.

Rooms.Name: The Temple
Rooms.Description:
You have entered the organizations own temple, dedicated to unearthly 
powers of old. The bloodstained floor with ancient inscriptions and the 
presence of something horrible makes you think that you probably should 
leave right now.

Exits.Description: The exit from the temple is to the south.
You see the temple-altar far to the south.

Rooms.Name: The eastern tapestries
Rooms.Description:
You are standing by a row of stone pillars made of a green unearthly 
type of rock. On the east wall you see huge tapestries of hellish demons entering human bodies. The realistic pictures make your poor stomach 
scream. You sense a very evil presence all around you searching for the 
right moment to steal your soul here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you look at the tapestries, you suddenly notice a movement in the 
picture. Are the demons for real?

The evil presence is all around you, seeking for a weakness in your 
iron will.

Rooms.Name: By a manmade mountain of coffins
Rooms.Description:
By the south wall there is a pile of coffins, made for human-sized 
bodies. All of them seems to have been forced open. Are the assassins 
grave robbers too? The columns that supports the ceiling are shaped 
like robed figures, praying to the altar to the south-west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The coffins are all empty.

Rooms.Name: By the Pentagram
Rooms.Description:
You are standing by a big Pentagram painted in red on the floor. As 
you look at it, it seems to rotate in a strange way on the ground. In 
the center of the pentagram stands a small statue resembling a demon. 
The dark priests probably summons demons here, to wreak the world of 
nice guys like yourself. You sense a strong evil presence from the south.

Exits.Description: You see a mountain of coffins to the east.
You see the Temple Altar to the south.

Rooms.Name: By the great fire
Rooms.Description:
A big fireplace is here, providing light to the evil temple . As you 
look into the red flames, you think you see faces of people in fear, 
just as if they were trapped into the fire. You also see some pieces of 
bones in the ashes here.

Exits.Description: You see a Pentagram on the floor to the east.

Rooms.Name: Dimly lit part of the temple
Rooms.Description:
As you look around here, you notice that it's strangely dark. To the 
south you see a big fireplace, but somehow the light fails to get here. 
On the walls you see dark tapestries with strange symbols woven into 
them.

Exits.Description: You see a big fireplace to the south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You fail to recognize most of the symbols, but catches your eye: 
triangle with a watching eye in the center. Wonder what that means...

Rooms.Name: The Temple Altar
Rooms.Description:
The evil presence is building up to gigantic proportions around the 
black altar in front of you. The surface of the altar is stained with 
gallons of coagulated blood and pieces of rotten corpses. The only exit 
from this horrible place is to the north.

Exits.Description: You see a pentagram on the floor to the north.

Rooms.Name: In the pool
Rooms.Description:
As you step into the pool, the acid burns your flesh. You look in 
fear at your feet as they slowly disintegrates. Suddenly you lose the 
grip and fall into the poisonous pool. You scream in agony as the 
poison enters your body and the acidic ingredients eats you raw.


                       Sorry Dude, You Died!!!!
        All that is left of you is some teeth at the bottom of the pool.

Rooms.Name: On the ladder
Rooms.Description:
As you try the old rungs they suddenly break and falls into the 
darkness below. Unfortunately you are joining them..... 

 AAAAAAAAA
         AAAAAAAAAAA
                   AAAAAAAAAAAA 
                               AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA 
--------------------------------------------------------->DEAD!!!!!!!!!

Rooms.Name: On an overgrown old road
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on an overgrown old road. High grass and bushes make 
it very hard to see that it actually has been a road. As you move 
further on the road you see some buildings to the north. The buildings 
looks like they once have been a farm. To the west you can see the 
remnants of an old barn and to the north lies the main building, and 
just before it you see an old well. The overgrown road turns eastwards 
here.

Rooms.Name: The Overgrown Road
Rooms.Description:
The road quickly turns back towards the north and continues uphill 
towards the mountains. The vegetation here is sparse, and not 
particularly healthy, and dry grasses crunch beneath your feet as you 
walk.

Rooms.Name: A Narrow Trail
Rooms.Description:
The road climbs as you continue north, it becomes more and more 
difficult to make out the old overgrown road, until all that is left 
is a narrow trail through the foothills. You could rediscover the old 
road if you go south from here, but a short steep section of the trail 
appears to lead to a plateau, and might be worth investigating.

Rooms.Name: A totally empty last room in the system
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a totally empty room with nothing in it and no 
where to go.

Mobs.Name: assassin guard sentry
Mobs.LongDescription: An assassin stands here, guarding the entrance to the ancient hideout.
Mobs.Description: He is completely dressed in black and looks very agile.

Mobs.Name: assassin cloak figure
Mobs.LongDescription: You see a a figure in the shadows floating at you.
Mobs.Description: All you can see is a the two yellow dots that must be the eyes.

Mobs.Name: shadow
Mobs.LongDescription: A shadow is moving around in the smoke.
Mobs.Description: Hmm a shadow without form? That must be it.

Mobs.Name: elf slave cook
Mobs.LongDescription: An elf slave is making a dinner here.
Mobs.Description:
The elf slave looks very depressed and must be constantly threatened by
the foul assassins.

Mobs.Name: poisonlord poison lord
Mobs.LongDescription: He grins at you and attacks!

Mobs.Name: torturer
Mobs.LongDescription: The torturer wants to try some new tools on you.
Mobs.Description: The torturer wears his standard outfit, red clothing and a black hood.

Mobs.Name: Gontran Master
Mobs.LongDescription: Gontran, Master of the Assassins, circles around you!
Mobs.Description:
Gontran is very muscular but looks quite agile too. He has a strange 
tattoe on the forehead that glows in evilly red.

Mobs.Name: assassin
Mobs.LongDescription: An assassin is sneaking around here.

Mobs.Name: statue
Mobs.LongDescription: A finelooking statue is standing here.
Mobs.Description:
The statues are carved out of the rock with excellent expertise. Maybe they are
made by a dwarven artist, captured by the wicked assassins.

Mobs.Name: priest dark cleric
Mobs.LongDescription: The dark priest stands here, eager to conjure up some demons.
Mobs.Description:
The look in his eyes make you think he is a real fanatic. The tattoes all over
his body seems to move around on his skin.

Mobs.Name: shade
Mobs.LongDescription: An assassin stands here in all the blood, grinning evilly at his awful deeds.

Mobs.Name: assassin man mirror
Mobs.LongDescription: You see a figure walking around in the reflections of the mirrors.
Mobs.Description: The figure looks quite unreal. It is dressed just like you!

Mobs.Name: hengist poor man
Mobs.LongDescription: A badly wounded man rests here, bearing the marks of the torturers tools.
Mobs.Description: He is in very bad condition.

Objects.Name: silk suit
Objects.Description: A suit of the finest black silk lies here.

Objects.Name: garrote
Objects.Description: A small garrote lies here in the rubble.

Objects.Name: amulet
Objects.Description: An oddlooking amulet lies here, made of stone.

Objects.Name: boots silk black
Objects.Description: A pair of black silk boots lies in the corner.

Objects.Name: key obsidian
Objects.Description: A key made of obsidian lies here.

Objects.Name: twilight key
Objects.Description: The key of twilight lies here.

Objects.Name: armor shadow
Objects.Description: A shadow armor lies here as a grey shadow in the floor.

Objects.Name: belt dark
Objects.Description: A belt made of dark matter lies here in the corner.

Objects.Name: book old ones
Objects.Description: A black book covered with green slime lies here.

Objects.Name: spoon
Objects.Description: A big spoon made of ebony lies here.

Objects.Name: statue green
Objects.Description: A small green statue stands in the middle of the room.

Objects.Name: barrel
Objects.Description: A barrel stands here in the dark corner of the room.

Objects.Name: key dungeon dungeons
Objects.Description: The key to the dungeons burns a hole in the floor here.

Objects.Name: jewelry
Objects.Description: Some expensive jewelry lies on a pillow here.
